method: Blind: candidates from scripts/messaging-label-candidates.mjs (an independent text search that imports no pipeline code), then one AI-assisted reading pass by two fresh-context labelling agents, each covering half the repositories, reading the checkouts and written rules, never Refit output, and searching each checkout beyond the candidates. The runner adjudicated one rule error against the SDK source (see adjudications). Not hand labelling and not second-labelled.
selection: Seeded order (seededSample in scripts/ai-app-helpers.mjs, seed 20261022) per provider group, first 5 per group that are within Refit scan limits counted before any scan (10,000 files, 50 MiB, 128 tsconfig/jsconfig files). Skipped as over a limit: MemberJunction/MJ, cedarjs/cedar, constructive-io/constructive, ever-works/ever-works, medusajs/medusa, molecule-dev/molecule, open-mercato/open-mercato, strapi/strapi.

rules.providers: used: live code loads the provider SDK and calls it, or requests the provider API host; a declaration alone, types, docs links and comments are not use. One entry per repository and provider.
rules.calls: deprecated: a call through a twilio client to a version-less accessor twilio 6.2.0 tags @deprecated, through a mailgun.js client to one of its deprecated domain methods, or a request to messaging.twilio.com/v1/Channels/WhatsApp/Senders.
rules.versions: below: the twilio version a package.json gets (lock, else the lowest the range allows) is below 6.0.0; null when it cannot be told.
rules.scope: live JavaScript and TypeScript source; tests, examples, fixtures, mocks and build output are out of scope.

adjudications.reason: client.api.accounts is not tagged @deprecated in twilio 6.2.0 (lib/rest/Api.d.ts declares get accounts() without a tag); the labeller marked it from memory, against the written rule
